iti80:2.3: Anavaññattipaṭisaṁyutto → -saññutto, P. Pa.; -saṁñutto, D. E. (pts note) | lābhasakkārasilokapaṭisaṁyutto → -saññutto, P. Pa. (pts note) | parānuddayatāpaṭisaṁyutto → parānudayatā-, B. M. P.; -tāya, Pa.; -saññutto, P. Pa. (pts note)

iti80:3.1: Anavaññattisaṁyutto → -saññutto, D. P. Pa.; -ṁññ-, C.; -ṁñ-, E. (pts note)
iti80:3.3: sahanandī → sahanandi (sya-all, pts) | sahanandi → sahanandi, D. E. M. P. Pa.; -nanti, B.; samānanti, C. (pts note) | amaccehi → amacceti, C. (pts note)
iti80:4.1: yo ca puttapasuṁ → yodha putte pasuṁ (sya-all) | puttapasuṁ → putte pasuṁ (pts) | hitvā → putta, M. Aa.; yo ca pasuṁ bhitvā, D. E. (pts note)
iti80:4.2: vivāhe saṁharāni → vivāso saṅgahāni (sya-all, pts) | saṁharāni → saṅgahāni (cck: ka. sī. syā. pī.) | vivāso → vivāhe, D. E. M. P. (pts note) | saṅgahāni → saṅgahāni, B. C.; santahāni, E.; santāh-, D.; saṅghaṁ hāni, P. Pa.; saṁharāni, M. A. mentions different readings, but the MS. is corrupt here; A seems to take the word as an acc. plur. (= “parikkhārāṇi”), but I think it is the nom. sg. of a compound saṅga-hāni. (pts note)
iti80:4.4: phuṭṭhuṁ → phuṭṭhuṁ, M.; phuṭṭhaṁ, B. P. Pa.; puṭṭhaṁ, C. D. E.; see sutt. 34. (pts note)
